sources.title: GitHub - nationaldesignstudio/rampart
sources.snippet: Rampart is a local-first system for removing personally identifiable information from user-typed text before it leaves the browser. It combines a 14.7 MB ONNX token-classification model with a deterministic recognizer layer; together they form a defense-in-depth pipeline released as a complete, reproducible artifact. This repository ships the runtime as @nationaldesignstudio/rampart. Model ...
